summary: Run the installed version 2 ordinary command on the retained public qualification clause after focused acceptance, then verify exact resume without new dispatch.
findings: The same existing 500-call allowance is used, starting at 144 consumed. This run has a fixed 24-call ceiling and a one-hour execution bound; failed attempts remain counted.

The source and issue are public retained material. The command receives no previous proposals, model criticisms, hidden reference formula or expected scenario. Development exposure remains a limitation.

Two isolated reader contexts, a missing-reading challenge, source criticism and one discrepancy reconsideration are required by the selected assurance method. Unresolved questions, behavioral disagreement, rejected proposals and non-executable readings remain visible.

Primary pass criterion is valid execution and complete preserved uncertainty with matching Java/Python consequences. A particular number of interpretations, agreement with a favored parse, or a no-discrepancy result is not required.
H0 must pass before this reviewed phase starts. Missing or altered evidence, source/method drift, authority failure or exhausted limits stops dependent processing and requires a recorded repair.

The subsequent audit resumes the completed command with identical bindings, verifies every receipt and manifest, requires zero additional calls, and checks the final comparison against the retained candidates.
No rank, legal error rate, review cost saving or institution release is inferred. Missing bank host and factual evidence contracts remain separate deployment inputs.
